in_sanskrit.name: भविनी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: भव- (bhav) - to be, to exist, to create + नि- (ni) - towards + ई- (i) - feminine suffix Therefore, Bhavini means the one who creates or the one who exists towards creativity.

in_hindi.name: भविनी
in_hindi.long_meaning: भव- (bhav) - to be, to exist + नाती (nati) - one who is Bhavini in Hindi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhavini' which means 'one who exists towards creativity' or 'one who creates'.

in_tamil.name: பவினி
in_tamil.long_meaning: புலிகல் (puli) - tiger + கல் (kal) - strength + அவர்களுக்கு (avarkalukku) - for them + விழிக்கையில் (vizhikkaiyil) - in the midst of + வழிக்கையாள் (vazhikkaiyal) - one who helps Bhavini in Tamil means 'the one who helps tigers in the midst of their fights'.

in_telugu.name: భవినీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: భవ- (bhav) - to be, to exist + ధో (dha) - lord + శ్య (shyam) - the one who is dark Bhavini in Telugu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhavini' which means 'the dark lord who exists'.

in_marathi.name: Bhavini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of emotions, feelings
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhavini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhavini is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bhav’, which means emotion, feeling, or sentiments. The name Bhavini is a female form of the word and is often associated with the goddess of emotions, feelings, and sentiments. In Hindu mythology, Bhavani is the goddess of maternal love and is worshipped by women seeking the blessings of motherhood.
